title: Quiz App
description: Build a quiz application that presents questions, checks answers, tracks your score, and shows a final results screen.

steps.title: Create the question data structure
steps.description: Define an array of question objects. Each question has a `question` string, a `choices` array, and a `correctAnswer` string. Log the data to verify structure.
hints: Create at least 3 questions on different topics
Use JSON.stringify to log the full structure

verification.successMessage: Question data structure is set up with questions, choices, and correct answers!
verification.failureMessage: Make sure each question object has question, choices, and correctAnswer fields.

steps.title: Render a question
steps.description: Write a `renderQuestion` function that takes an index and logs the question with numbered choices, like: `"Q1: What is the capital of France?"` then `"1. London  2. Paris  3. Berlin  4. Madrid"`.
hints: Use the index to label the question: 'Q' + (index + 1)
Map choices to numbered strings: '1. London'
Join them with spaces or newlines for display

verification.successMessage: Questions render with numbered choices for the user to read!
verification.failureMessage: renderQuestion should log the question with a 'Q1' prefix and all 4 numbered choices.

steps.title: Check the selected answer
steps.description: Write a `checkAnswer` function that takes a question index and a selected answer. Log `"Correct!"` or `"Incorrect!"` based on whether it matches the correct answer.
hints: Log either 'Correct!' or 'Incorrect!' and return a boolean

verification.successMessage: Answers are checked correctly — right and wrong answers are detected!
verification.failureMessage: checkAnswer(0, 'Paris') should log 'Correct!' and return true. checkAnswer(0, 'London') should log 'Incorrect!' and return false.

steps.title: Track the score
steps.description: Create a `score` variable and an `answerQuestion` function that checks the answer, increments the score if correct, and logs the current score.
hints: Initialize let score = 0 outside the function
If correct, increment score by 1 and log 'Score: ' + score

verification.successMessage: Score tracking works — correct answers add points!
verification.failureMessage: answerQuestion(0, 'Paris') should log 'Correct!' and set score to 1. answerQuestion(1, '3') should log 'Incorrect!'

steps.title: Show the results screen
steps.description: Write a `showResults` function that calculates the percentage and logs a summary: `"You scored X out of Y (Z%)"` with a pass/fail message.
hints: Display: 'You scored ' + score + ' out of ' + questions.length + ' (' + percent + '%)'

verification.successMessage: Results screen shows the final score with percentage and feedback!
verification.failureMessage: showResults should display '2 out of 3 (67%)' with 'Try again!' message for a score below 70%.
